$comment: The model registry: one source of truth for current models, their prices and
the parameters they accept. A Drop means editing this file.
Every entry was read off the vendor's own documentation on `verified_on` and
carries the page it came from in `source`. A model whose facts we could not
confirm from a vendor source is left out rather than guessed at.
Prices are US dollars per million tokens, standard (non-batch, non-cached)
rates. `effort_levels` are the provider's own level names, in ascending order;
an empty list means the model has no effort control. `accepts_sampling_params`
is false when a non-default temperature/top_p is rejected OR silently ignored,
because in both cases sending it is a lie about what the request does.

models.sampling_note: a non-default temperature, top_p or top_k returns a 400 on Claude Opus 4.7 and later; effort is the only thinking control.
models.notes: Sampling parameters removed: a non-default temperature, top_p or top_k returns 400 on Claude Opus 4.7 and later. Effort is the only thinking control.

models.sampling_note: a non-default temperature, top_p or top_k returns a 400 on Claude Opus 4.7 and later models, this one included.
models.notes: Post-4.7 sampling-parameter removal applies. Default effort high per the models overview.
Predates the 4.7 sampling-parameter removal, so temperature is accepted. The models overview lists effort as not supported, so effort is dropped for this model.

models.sampling_note: temperature and top_p are unsupported whenever reasoning effort is not "none".
models.notes: Tool calling goes through the Responses API; Chat Completions supports function calling only at reasoning_effort none. temperature and top_p are unsupported whenever effort is not none, so we never send them.

models.sampling_note: temperature and top_p are unsupported whenever reasoning effort is not "none".
models.notes: Same Responses-API-for-tools and unsupported-sampling rules as gpt-6-sol.
Effort is thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel; the model page says minimal returns an error. Prices are the paid-tier standard rates in force through 2026-12-31.

models.sampling_note: thinking mode is on by default and ignores temperature; the value is accepted but has no effect, so sending it would misrepresent the request.
models.notes: Thinking mode is on by default and does not support temperature: the value is accepted but has no effect, so sending it would misrepresent the request. Prices are peak rates; off-peak is half.

reasoning_effort defaults to high and reasoning cannot be disabled. temperature is a documented chat-completions parameter; only presence_penalty, frequency_penalty and stop are rejected on reasoning models.
